title: FreeCast Announces Major Partnership with ROKiT Flix to Expand Global Streaming Entertainment Service - Press Release - FreeCast
summary: FreeCast and ROKiT Flix partner to expand streaming choices with more free TV, on-demand content, and optional premium services.
body_markdown:
ORLANDO, Fla.--([BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com/) )--ROKiT Flix, the world's first and largest completely free, advertising-free streaming entertainment service, has signed a major partnership agreement with FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST), a leading provider of streaming technology and media solutions.


Free to download, free to watch and completely free from advertising, ROKiT Flix offers more than 50,000 hours of family-friendly entertainment, including animated movies, 2D and 3D animation, classic cartoons, motion comics and original programming.


Created by ROKiT Studios, ROKiT Flix has rapidly established itself as a global entertainment destination, with approximately 2.9 million estimated Android installations as of October 2026, according to independent application analytics provider AppBrain.


The new agreement with FreeCast will significantly expand the entertainment choices available to ROKiT Flix audiences by introducing a complementary, ROKiT Flix-branded streaming marketplace powered by FreeCast's advanced Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) technology.


This expanded offering will provide access to additional free television channels, on-demand movies and entertainment, as well as optional premium subscription services, while preserving the completely free and advertising-free experience that lies at the heart of ROKiT Flix.


The complementary FreeCast-powered marketplace is expected to include advertising-supported programming and optional paid subscriptions. Content and service availability will vary by market and applicable programming rights. ROKiT Flix’s existing core service will remain a separate free, advertising-free offering.


Jonathan Kendrick, Chairman of ROKiT, said:


“We are absolutely delighted to be partnering with FreeCast. From the very beginning, our vision for ROKiT Flix has been to make great entertainment available to everyone, everywhere, completely free of charge and without the interruption of advertising.”


“With more than 50,000 hours of family-friendly entertainment already available on ROKiT Flix, we have built something truly unique. We believe that everyone should be able to enjoy quality entertainment without having to pay subscription fees or sit through endless advertisements.”


“Our partnership with FreeCast represents an exciting next chapter for ROKiT Flix. The planned complementary marketplace is intended to give our audiences additional entertainment choices, including live television channels, movies and optional premium content. We remain committed to maintaining our existing core ROKiT Flix service as free to download, free to watch and advertising-free.”


“We look forward to working closely with William Mobley and his team at FreeCast to make this expanded entertainment experience available to ROKiT Flix audiences in supported markets.”


Under the agreement, ROKiT Flix will integrate and promote access to a new branded entertainment experience powered by FreeCast's streaming technology.


The expanded service is expected to offer a broad range of additional entertainment options, including free streaming television channels, video-on-demand programming, movies and premium subscription services.


Importantly, ROKiT Flix's existing library of more than 50,000 hours of entertainment will remain completely free and advertising-free. The additional FreeCast-powered marketplace will be a complementary offering, with some programming potentially supported by advertising or available through optional paid subscriptions.


The partnership brings together ROKiT Flix's growing international audience and extensive entertainment library with FreeCast's established streaming infrastructure and content aggregation capabilities.


William Mobley, Founder and CEO of FreeCast, commented:


“ROKiT Flix represents exactly the type of opportunity our Platform-as-a-Service model was designed to support. They have already invested in building an impressive entertainment brand, an extensive family-friendly content library and a substantial consumer distribution network.”


“FreeCast provides the technology infrastructure to help extend that investment into a much broader entertainment marketplace, bringing additional television channels, on-demand content and premium services to ROKiT Flix viewers.”


“Our business model is fundamentally different from traditional streaming services. We are not trying to replace the brands consumers already know and enjoy. Instead, we provide the technology that allows those brands to expand their offerings, introduce additional services and develop new revenue opportunities.”


“We are very pleased to be working with Jonathan Kendrick and the ROKiT Flix team, and we look forward to helping them take their entertainment offering to the next level.”


By combining ROKiT Flix's distinctive entertainment offering with FreeCast's streaming marketplace technology, the two companies intend to create additional opportunities for content discovery, distribution and audience growth.


The agreement also demonstrates the versatility of FreeCast's technology, which enables established consumer brands, telecommunications companies, broadcasters and entertainment providers to offer expanded streaming services without having to develop their own complex technology infrastructure.


The companies will work together on the implementation of the expanded ROKiT Flix experience, with further details regarding availability and rollout to be announced in due course.


**About ROKiT Flix**


ROKiT Flix is the world's first and largest completely free, advertising-free streaming entertainment service, offering more than 50,000 hours of family-friendly programming.


Created by ROKiT Studios, the platform offers a vast library of entertainment including 2D and 3D animation, animated movies, classic cartoons, original productions and motion comics powered by ROKiT Motionise technology.


ROKiT Flix is completely free to download, completely free to watch and contains no advertising or subscription fees within its core service.


Available through mobile applications and web browsers, ROKiT Flix is committed to making quality entertainment accessible to audiences around the world.


**About FreeCast, Inc.**


FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST) is a streaming technology company providing a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed to help businesses deliver, aggregate and monetize digital entertainment.


FreeCast's software platform enables telecommunications companies, internet service providers, wireless operators, broadcasters, content providers and consumer brands to offer customized streaming television, video-on-demand, subscription management and digital media services.


Through its integrated technology, FreeCast seeks to simplify streaming distribution, reduce duplicative technology requirements and create additional monetization opportunities for businesses with established consumer relationships.
